Supreme Court seeks government action on child sexual abuse material

The Supreme Court has demanded a response from the government regarding measures to prevent child sexual abuse material (CSAM) from being uploaded or appearing on online platforms. A bench comprising Justices J.B. Pardiwala and K. Vinod Chandran issued a directive to the government to consider such steps. This action follows a petition filed by the 'Just Rights for Children Alliance'.
